https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 参议院周二决定启动立法，要求联邦首都领地的租户在租赁阿布贾公寓前出示有效身份证明，以遏制犯罪活动。参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿卡皮奥指示参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱起草法案，供国民议会审议。阿卡皮奥先生在议员们讨论参议院各委员会关于保护尼日利亚人免遭拐运至利比亚沦为奴隶的报告时下达了该指示。相关委员会包括侨民与非政府组织委员会，司法、人权与法律事务委员会，外交委员会以及特别职责委员会。报告由参议院侨民与非政府组织委员会主席阿尼坎·巴西提交。阿卡皮奥先生表示担忧，许多房东在未充分了解租户身份、职业及其他相关信息的情况下，便将房产出租给陌生人。他认为，缺少适当文件会使安全机构在犯罪发生后难以追查嫌疑人，让作案者逃脱且不留下明确线索。他说：“很多人直接把房产交给陌生人。他们甚至没有任何文件可以证明租户来自哪里。在某些情况下，租房时留下的电话号码甚至不属于房屋实际居住者。因此，一旦发生事情，那个人就会逃走，并且不会留下任何痕迹。”参议院议长敦促巴米德莱先生考虑制定法律，加强租赁监管，并促使房东对核实潜在租户身份承担更多责任。他说：“有人怀着极其恶劣的意图进入他人的房产，最终实施犯罪、拐卖他人的children，从中获利，同时还住在房子里。对于租赁问题，我们必须收紧法律。”阿卡皮奥先生提议采用类似银行业“了解你的客户”（KYC）政策的做法，该政策要求金融机构核实客户身份。他说：“正如你们所知，银行会要求‘了解你的客户’；对于这件事，我们可以说‘了解你的租户’。例如，我们可以为联邦首都领地制定必要的法律。我们可以为联邦首都领地颁布一项规定，要求‘了解你的租户’，这样就不会有人入住房屋并实施犯罪。”他说，拟议立法也可涵盖商店及其他商业场所的租赁，并认为身份核验不足可能使占用者和商户遭受犯罪袭击。阿卡皮奥先生说，租用商店的人应提供可核实的身份证明，包括驾驶证或国际护照，以便在涉嫌犯罪时帮助安全机构追踪他们。他说，缺乏可靠的租户信息，可能导致房东无法识别或协助寻找利用其场所实施犯罪的人。他还说：“对于那些要租用小商铺的人，我们也可以借此监管小商铺，因为人们会进入偏僻场所经营小商铺，随后在夜间实施抢劫并逃走。”为支持自己的论点，阿卡皮奥先生提到其担任阿夸伊博姆州州长时为打击绑架而采取的措施。他说，其政府规定对绑架行为处以死刑，并推出措施，摧毁犯罪分子用作藏身点的房产。参议院议长指出，这些措施促使房东留意其场所内的活动，并因担心失去房产而报告可疑行为。他说，类似措施也有助于阻止犯罪分子把出租公寓和商业场所当作犯罪活动据点。如果按照参议院议长的设想颁布，拟议立法将要求联邦首都领地的房东在出租房产前核实潜在租户身份。该提案旨在帮助安全机构根据住址追踪涉嫌犯罪的人员，并阻止犯罪分子将出租公寓和商业场所作为藏身点。然而，其成效将取决于法律的具体条款，包括如何核实身份、房东须保存哪些记录，以及如何监督合规情况。法律若获颁布，调查人员将更容易确认与出租房产有关联的租户身份。该法律还可能对房东和房地产中介施加额外责任，或要求他们保留身份证明记录，并在法律要求时向获授权机关提供相关信息。不过，该提案也可能引发对隐私、租户个人信息安全以及房东利用该要求歧视潜在租户或拒绝向无法迅速提供规定文件者提供住所的担忧。《尼日利亚数据保护法》2023为合法、安全处理个人信息提供了框架。任何要求房东收集并保存租户身份信息的系统，都必须遵守适用的数据保护义务。根据参议院议长所述的会议进展，该提案目前仍处于起草阶段，须经过立法程序才能成为法律

https://leadership.ng/reps-demand-regula.body: Consequently, the House urged the Federal Government to establish a transparent licensing and approval framework for the commercial importation of EVs, CNG vehicles and related clean mobility equipment. It asked the National Automotive Design and Development Council (NADDC), in collaboration with the Bureau of Public Procurement (BPP), the Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON), the Nigeria Customs Service (NCS), and other relevant agencies, to develop objective qualification criteria for import approval. These resolutions were a result of the adoption of a motion sponsored by Hon. Ademorin Aliu Kuye(APC, Lagos) at plenary on Tuesday. Moving the motion, he noted that Nigeria had adopted policies promoting the transition to EVs, CNG vehicles, Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) vehicles, and other clean transportation technologies as part of its energy transition and economic diversification agenda. According to him, Nigeria has the opportunity to encourage local investment, technology transfer, employment generation, and domestic value addition by linking import incentives to measurable investments in infrastructure and technical capacity. It further asked the Federal Government to align tax incentives, import duty concessions, and other fiscal benefits with compliance with this regulatory framework to promote sustained investment in local infrastructure. The House mandated the Committees on Industry, Commerce, Gas Resources, Environment, and Legislative Compliance to monitor implementation and report within four weeks for legislative action. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/adc-.body: The African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council (ADC-PCC) has urged the National Assembly to reject President Bola Tinubu’s proposed $20 billion and £1 billion foreign borrowing unless the Federal Government provides full details of the facilities and demonstrates their benefits to Nigerians. The council said the fresh borrowing would add to the burden on Nigerians already battling rising living costs and increased taxation, questioning why the government was seeking more loans without accounting for previous borrowings and savings from fuel subsidy removal. In a statement by its Director of Media and Publicity, Kola Ologbondiyan, the ADC-PCC faulted the administration’s borrowing plans, demanding evidence that the funds would translate into tangible improvements in citizens’ lives. “What exactly is President Tinubu borrowing all this money for? Where are the roads, the electricity, the hospitals, the jobs and the critical infrastructure that should justify this relentless accumulation of debt? Nigerians deserve answers,” Ologbondiyan said. He questioned why the government was returning to international creditors while millions of Nigerians struggled to survive the effects of its economic policies. The council warned that continued borrowing without transparent spending and measurable returns could deepen Nigeria’s debt burden, restrict future governments’ policy options and threaten the country’s economic sovereignty. “This is not a sustainable path to national development. It is a dangerous attempt to mortgage the future of Nigeria and generations yet unborn,” Ologbondiyan said. The ADC-PCC demanded that Tinubu publish a comprehensive account of all domestic and foreign borrowing since May 29, 2023, including a breakdown of revenue realised from subsidy removal and how the funds had been spent. It also called for full disclosure of the proposed loans’ purposes, interest rates, repayment periods, fees, conditions and any collateral or guarantees attached to the facilities. “Nigeria cannot borrow its way out of poor economic management. Borrowing must be tied to clearly defined national priorities, transparent expenditure and measurable outcomes. Anything less is an injustice to the Nigerian people,” the council said. It urged lawmakers to insist on accountability and refuse to approve the facilities until the Federal Government establishes their necessity, sustainability and tangible benefits to Nigerians. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/adc-.body_zh: 非洲民主大会全国竞选委员会（ADC-PCC）敦促国民议会否决总统博拉·蒂努布拟议的200亿美元和10亿英镑外债，除非联邦政府提供这些融资安排的完整细节，并向尼日利亚人民证明其益处。该委员会表示，新一轮借款将加重尼日利亚民众的负担；他们已在应对生活成本上涨和税收增加带来的压力。委员会质疑，在未说明此前借款情况以及取消燃料补贴所节省资金去向的情况下，政府为何还要寻求更多贷款。ADC-PCC媒体与公共事务主任科拉·奥洛格博迪扬在一份声明中批评政府的借款计划，要求提供证据，证明这些资金将切实改善公民的生活。奥洛格博迪扬说：“蒂努布总统究竟借这么多钱做什么？那些本应为持续累积债务提供理由的道路、电力、医院、就业岗位和关键基础设施在哪里？尼日利亚人民有权得到答案。”他质疑，在数百万尼日利亚人仍在艰难应对其经济政策影响之际，政府为何要重新向国际债权人借款。该委员会警告，在缺乏透明支出和可衡量回报的情况下持续借款，可能加深尼日利亚的债务负担，限制未来政府的政策选择，并威胁国家经济主权。奥洛格博迪扬说：“这不是通往国家发展的可持续道路，而是企图拿尼日利亚的未来以及尚未出生世代的未来作抵押的危险做法。”ADC-PCC要求蒂努布公布自2023年5月29日以来所有国内外借款的综合账目，包括取消补贴所得收入的明细，以及这些资金的支出情况。该委员会还要求全面披露拟议贷款的用途、利率、偿还期限、费用、附带条件，以及融资安排涉及的任何抵押或担保。该委员会说：“尼日利亚不能靠借款摆脱经济管理不善。借款必须与明确界定的国家优先事项、透明的支出和可衡量的成果相挂钩。任何低于这一要求的行为，都是对尼日利亚人民的不公。”该委员会敦促议员坚持问责，在联邦政府证明有关融资安排的必要性、可持续性及其对尼日利亚人民的切实益处之前，拒绝批准这些融资安排。本文所载评论不代表Vanguard报纸及其任何员工的观点

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Foreign tourist arrivals in Korea this year are estimated to have already set an all-time annual record, the culture ministry said Tuesday. Preliminary figures from the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism showed that this year's arrivals reached about 18.91 million through Monday, and the total is believed to have surpassed the previous annual record of 18.94 million, set last year, Tuesday, with more than two months left in the year. The ministry expects about 1.94 million people to visit next month if the current trend continues, with the annual total topping 20 million for the first time in the third week of November. Visitor numbers rose across most major markets, including Chinese-speaking regions, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe and the Americas. Growth is also spreading beyond Seoul, with more foreign tourists entering the country through regional airports and ports and visiting areas outside the capital, a trend Chae described as "very encouraging." "We will focus not only on quantitative expansion but also on strengthening quality so that Korea can firmly establish itself as an irreplaceable travel destination in the global tourism market," Chae said in a press release. Foreign visitors' spending also jumped 47.7 percent from a year earlier, driven mainly by shopping, accommodation, and medical and wellness services. The government attributed the record numbers to the global popularity of Korean pop culture, innovation by the tourism industry and public hospitality toward foreign visitors

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary_zh: 总统博拉·蒂努布已向参议院提交一项法案，请求授权尼日利亚政府与其他国家达成协议，将已定罪的尼日利亚公民移交至尼日利亚服刑。该法案拟修订《2004年已定罪罪犯移交法及实施法》，以便根据双方协议促进尼日利亚与其他国家之间移交已定罪罪犯。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: President Bola Tinubu has transmitted a bill to the Senate seeking to empower the Nigerian government to enter into agreements with other countries for the transfer of convicted Nigerian citizens to serve their sentences in Nigeria. The bill seeks to amend the Transfer of Convicted Offenders Enactment and Enforcement Act, 2004, to facilitate the transfer of convicted offenders between Nigeria and other countries under mutual agreements. Mr Tinubu transmitted the bill to the Senate in a letter read by Senate President Godswill Akpabio during plenary on Tuesday. In the letter, the president said the proposed legislation would empower the Nigerian government to enter into agreements with other countries for the transfer of convicted offenders to Nigeria. He also said the legislation would enable Nigeria to honour similar requests from foreign governments, subject to the terms of the agreements. He added that the bill would empower the president, through an order published in the Federal Gazette, to apply the law to any country with which Nigeria had entered into such an agreement. According to him, this would facilitate the implementation of agreements with countries outside the Commonwealth. After reading the president’s letter, Mr Akpabio referred the bill to the Senate Committee on Rules and Business for further legislative consideration. Nigeria has had several cases involving public officials and political figures convicted by foreign courts. Among them is former Delta State Governor James Ibori, who was sentenced to 13 years in prison in the United Kingdom in 2012 after pleading guilty to money laundering offences. He was released in 2016. Former Deputy Senate President Ike Ekweremadu was sentenced to nine years and eight months in prison in the UK in 2023 for his role in an organ-trafficking conspiracy involving a young man. Similarly, Abidemi Rufai, a former aide to Ogun State Governor Dapo Abiodun, was sentenced to five years in prison in the United States in 2022 for wire fraud and aggravated identity theft. Nigeria and the United Kingdom already have a prisoner-transfer agreement that provides for eligible prisoners to serve their sentences in their home countries, subject to the applicable conditions and the agreement of both governments. The proposed amendment seeks to provide a legal framework for implementing prisoner-transfer agreements with countries outside the Commonwealth. However, the proposed legislation would not automatically entitle every Nigerian convicted abroad to be transferred home, as eligibility would depend on the relevant agreement and its conditions
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: 920714 蒂努布向参议院提交法案，允许将境外已定罪的尼日利亚人移交回国
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 尼日利亚总统博拉·蒂努布已向参议院提交一项法案，寻求授权尼日利亚政府与其他国家达成协议，将已定罪的尼日利亚公民移交至尼日利亚服刑。该法案拟修订《2004年已定罪犯移交法及实施法》，以便根据双方协议，在尼日利亚与其他国家之间移交已定罪犯。蒂努布先生周二在参议院全体会议上通过参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿卡皮奥宣读的一封信，将法案提交参议院。总统在信中表示，拟议立法将授权尼日利亚政府与其他国家达成协议，将已定罪犯移交至尼日利亚。他还表示，该立法将使尼日利亚能够根据协议条款，满足外国政府提出的类似请求。他补充说，法案将授权总统通过在《联邦公报》上发布命令，将该法适用于与尼日利亚达成此类协议的任何国家。据他所说，这将有助于实施与英联邦以外国家达成的协议。阿卡皮奥先生宣读总统信件后，将法案提交参议院规则与事务委员会作进一步立法审议。尼日利亚已发生多起涉及被外国法院定罪的公职人员和政治人物的案件。其中包括前三角洲州州长詹姆斯·伊博里，他于2012年在英国承认洗钱罪行后被判处13年监禁，并于2016年获释。前参议院副议长艾克·埃克韦马杜因参与涉及一名年轻男子的人体器官贩运阴谋，于2023年在英国被判处9年8个月监禁。同样，奥贡州州长达波·阿比奥杜恩的前助手阿比德米·鲁法伊因电汇欺诈和加重身份盗窃，于2022年被美国判处5年监禁。尼日利亚与英国已签署囚犯移交协议，规定符合条件的囚犯可在其本国服刑，但须遵守适用条件并获得两国政府同意。拟议修正案旨在为实施与英联邦以外国家达成的囚犯移交协议提供法律框架。不过，拟议立法并不会自动赋予所有在海外被定罪的尼日利亚人回国服刑的权利，其资格取决于相关协议及其条件

https://leadership.ng/federal-government.body: The call came during a panel discussion at a breakout session of the 32nd Nigerian Economic Summit in Abuja on Monday. Minister of State for Industry, Trade and Investment, Senator John Owan Enoh, said the informal nature of many small businesses remained a major barrier to accessing financing. He said some enterprises had struggled to meet documentation requirements for intervention funds, including the N5 billion MSME component of the N200 billion intervention fund. He urged measures to encourage business registration and formalisation, while calling for stronger capacity-building to enable small businesses to access credit and participate in the formal economy. Enoh also said the Federal Government was working to connect MSMEs with larger manufacturers to create more dependable supply opportunities and deepen their participation in industrial value chains. He further called for an updated census of MSMEs, noting that the current estimate of 39 million enterprises was based on 2020 data and no longer reflected present realities. The Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of FirstBank, Olusegun Alebiosu, said improving MSME access to finance required a coordinated approach involving commercial banks, microfinance banks, development finance institutions and government. Alebiosu, represented by his Technical Adviser, Akinsope Roberts, said FirstBank had introduced financing products for businesses, including women-owned enterprises and traders. He, however, stressed that access to credit still depended on business viability and cash flow. He said the bank’s FirstCredit product had disbursed more than N1 trillion since its introduction about six years ago. According to him, the facility provides short-term working capital, with some customers borrowing for three to five days to meet immediate stock and supply needs. Alebiosu said MSMEs required different financing arrangements depending on their size and stage of development, adding that the needs of petty traders and micro-enterprises differed from those of larger businesses. He called for closer coordination between financial institutions and government to ensure that credit reached businesses through appropriate products and repayment structures. Economic Adviser to the Katsina State Governor, Khalil Nur Khalil, said governments needed to improve access to finance, training, capacity building and infrastructure to support MSME development. Khalil identified reliable data, policy alignment, public-private partnerships and business-environment reforms as critical to improving the operating conditions of small businesses. He said accurate data would help governments identify businesses, understand their financing and operational needs, and design suitable policies. He also called for better coordination among federal, state and local government policies, particularly to align industrial development strategies with MSME support programmes. Managing director of Prothrive (GrandLos PAP), Oluyemisi Obe, called for financing schemes and support programmes that reflect the changing needs of businesses as they expand. She said some MSMEs outgrew the financing initially provided to them but continued to face limitations because intervention programmes did not adequately address their growth. Obe cited her experience with the Lagos State Employment Trust Fund, which provided her business with a N5 million loan in 2016, saying the business had since expanded beyond the initial financing level. She urged policymakers to conduct gap analyses to identify the needs of businesses at different stages of development and ensure that support programmes evolved alongside them. Obe also advocated legislation at federal and state levels to provide a lasting policy framework for MSME development and reduce policy disruption caused by changes in administration. A Professor of International Studies at the Graduate School of International Management, Gaku Funabashi, called for an MSME development strategy tailored to Nigeria’s economic conditions rather than the wholesale adoption of policies from other countries. https://leadership.ng/federal-government.body_zh: 这通电话是在周一于阿布贾举行的第32届尼日利亚经济峰会分组会议专题讨论期间打来的。工业、贸易与投资部国务部长、参议员约翰·奥万·埃诺赫表示，许多小企业的非正规经营性质仍是获得融资的主要障碍。他说，一些企业难以满足干预资金的文件要求，其中包括2000亿奈拉干预基金下的50亿奈拉中小企业组成部分。他敦促采取措施鼓励企业注册和正规化，同时呼吁加强能力建设，使小企业能够获得信贷并参与正规经济。埃诺赫还表示，联邦政府正在努力将中小企业与大型制造商连接起来，以创造更可靠的供应机会，并加深其对产业价值链的参与。他还呼吁更新中小企业普查数据，并指出目前估计的3900万家企业采用的是2020年的数据，已无法反映当前实际情况。FirstBank董事总经理兼首席执行官奥卢塞贡·阿莱比奥苏表示，改善中小企业获得融资的情况，需要商业银行、微型金融机构、开发金融机构和政府采取协调一致的行动。阿莱比奥苏由技术顾问阿金索佩·罗伯茨代表出席。他说，FirstBank已推出面向企业的融资产品，其中包括女性拥有的企业和贸易商。然而，他强调，获得信贷仍取决于企业的可行性和现金流。他说，该银行的FirstCredit产品自约六年前推出以来，已发放超过1万亿奈拉。据他介绍，该信贷安排提供短期营运资金，一些客户借款期为3至5天，以满足即时备货和供应需求。阿莱比奥苏表示，中小企业需要根据其规模和发展阶段采用不同的融资安排，小商贩和微型企业的需求与较大企业不同。他呼吁金融机构与政府加强协调，确保企业能够通过适当的产品和还款结构获得信贷。卡塔萨州州长的经济顾问哈利勒·努尔·哈利勒表示，政府需要改善融资获取渠道，并加强培训、能力建设和基础设施，以支持中小企业发展。哈利勒指出，可靠的数据、政策协调一致、公私伙伴关系以及营商环境改革，是改善小企业经营环境的关键。他说，准确的数据将有助于政府识别企业、了解其融资和运营需求，并制定适当的政策。他还呼吁加强联邦、州和地方政府政策之间的协调，尤其是推动工业发展战略与中小企业支持计划相互衔接。Prothrive（GrandLos PAP）董事总经理奥卢耶米西·奥贝呼吁推出能够反映企业扩张过程中需求变化的融资方案和支持计划。她说，一些中小企业的规模已经超过最初获得的融资规模，但由于干预计划未能充分满足其成长需求，它们仍面临限制。奥贝提到她与拉各斯州就业信托基金合作的经验，该基金于2016年向她家企业提供了500万奈拉贷款，如今该企业的发展规模已远超初始融资水平。她敦促政策制定者开展差距分析，识别处于不同发展阶段企业的需求，并确保支持计划随企业一同演进。奥贝还主张在联邦和州层面制定法律，为中小企业发展提供持久的政策框架，并减少政府换届造成的政策中断。国际管理研究生院国际研究教授加库·舟桥山呼吁制定符合尼日利亚经济状况的中小企业发展战略，而不是全盘照搬其他国家的政策。他说，政策制定者应确定重点行业，并明确中小企业能够供应哪些产品和支持性零部件，以促进其发展。我们掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，随时随地获取最新消息 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/he.summary_zh: 联邦政府正与美国机构“终结饥饿行动”合作，动员超过10亿美元，对抗儿童营养不良并防止撒哈拉以南非洲各地发生与饥饿有关的死亡，尼日利亚是重点国家。据Tinubu夫人媒体高级特别助理Busola Kukoyi发表的声明，该倡议旨在通过与政府合作，支持尼日利亚解决饥饿和儿童营养不良问题的努力。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/he.body: The federal government is partnering with a US-based organisation, Operation End Starvation, to mobilise more than $1 billion to combat child malnutrition and prevent starvation-related deaths across sub-Saharan Africa, with Nigeria as a priority country. The partnership was announced on Monday when the Coordinating Minister of Health and Social Welfare, Muhammad Pate, led a delegation from the organisation and other agencies under the ministry to meet with the wife of the president, Oluremi Tinubu, to discuss areas of collaboration. According to a statement issued by Busola Kukoyi, the Senior Special Assistant on Media to Mrs Tinubu, the initiative aims to support Nigeria’s efforts to address hunger and child malnutrition through partnerships with the government. Operation End Starvation, an initiative of the Eleanor Crook Foundation, is a public-private partnership focused on ending child malnutrition and deaths associated with starvation across sub-Saharan Africa. The Chief Executive Officer of Operation End Starvation, Williams Moore, said the initiative aims to direct more than $1 billion towards preventing child deaths caused by starvation. He said the programme, supported by a grant from the US government and contributions from global philanthropists, would focus on sub-Saharan Africa over the next two years, with Nigeria among its priority countries. “We want to move one billion to end starvation in the next two years across Sub Saharan Africa. The burden is high but the capacity is also very high,” Mr Moore said. He said the US State Department had approved Nigeria’s inclusion in the initiative. “The foundation is impressed by Nigeria’s focus on combating acute malnutrition and we are seeking partnership for this global ‘Operation End Starvation’ programme,” he said. “We have met with the Nigeria health team and they are one of the best of many we have met.” Mr Pate said the partnership would support the government’s existing efforts to combat hunger and malnutrition. He cited the National Community Food Bank Programme, implemented in partnership with the Office of the First Lady, as one of the initiatives aimed at improving access to food across the country’s six geopolitical zones. “Nigeria is working hard to scale down its 6.4 million figure of acute child malnutrition, while also attending to the health of pregnant women and lactating mothers,” Mr Pate said. He added that several interventions were already underway to address the country’s nutritional challenges. Mrs Tinubu welcomed the proposed partnership, praising the expertise and commitment of government officials working across different sectors. “It’s been a delight working with Prof. Pate, Dr Muyi and others. I also work with the Ministry of Education and others. The manpower we have now in the ministries are so wonderful,” Mrs Tinubu said. She said President Bola Tinubu’s administration was working to overhaul the country’s systems, adding that Nigeria deserved better public services and effective use of available resources. “Nigeria deserves better and there is nothing we give to her that is too much because if the system works, it will ultimately come back to us,” she said. “I assure you that whatever aid you give us, this health team would put it to good use.” She also expressed confidence in the capacity of the country’s health team to ensure that assistance provided through the partnership was put to effective use. Nigeria continues to face significant challenges in addressing child malnutrition, particularly among children under five. According to figures cited by the health minister, the country has an estimated 6.4 million cases of acute child malnutrition. The federal government says it is working to reduce this burden while addressing the nutritional needs of pregnant women and breastfeeding mothers. Another data by the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF), estimates that about 100 children under five die of malnutrition per hour in Nigeria, approximately 2,400 children daily. It also explained that an estimated two million children under five in the country suffer from Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM), but only two out of every 10 children affected receive treatment. Research shows that malnutrition in Nigeria is a multifaceted issue with several contributing factors, which include poverty, food insecurity, inadequate infant and young child feeding practices, lack of access to healthcare, and poor sanitation. Factors like conflict, lack of education, and gender inequality also contribute. The 2023-2024 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey ( NDHS ) shows rising malnutrition across categories: stunting, wasting, and underweight children, with males slightly more affected than females. According to the data, 50.64 per cent of underweight children in Nigeria are male. The Eleanor Crook Foundation’s Operation End Starvation initiative aims to use direct partnerships with governments to demonstrate how large-scale investments can help end child malnutrition and prevent starvation-related deaths across sub-Saharan Africa
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/he.title_zh: 联邦政府与美国基金会合作，动员10亿美元应对儿童营养不良
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/he.body_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府正与美国机构“终结饥饿行动”合作，计划筹集超过10亿美元，对抗撒哈拉以南非洲的儿童营养不良问题，并防止与饥饿有关的死亡，尼日利亚被列为重点国家。该合作于星期一宣布。卫生与社会福利部协调部长穆罕默德·帕特率领该机构及卫生部其他机构代表团，会见总统夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努巴，讨论合作领域。根据蒂努巴夫人媒体高级特别助手布索拉·库科伊发表的声明，该倡议旨在通过与政府建立伙伴关系，支持尼日利亚解决饥饿和儿童营养不良问题的努力。“终结饥饿行动”是埃莉诺·克鲁克基金会发起的一项公私合作计划，宗旨是在撒哈拉以南非洲消除儿童营养不良以及与饥饿有关的死亡。“终结饥饿行动”首席执行官威廉斯·摩尔表示，该倡议计划投入超过10亿美元，防止饥饿造成的儿童死亡。他说，该项目得到美国政府拨款和全球慈善家出资的支持，未来两年将重点覆盖撒哈拉以南非洲，尼日利亚是重点国家之一。摩尔说：“我们希望在未来两年内投入10亿，在整个撒哈拉以南非洲终结饥饿。这里负担沉重，但应对能力也非常强。”他说，美国国务院已批准将尼日利亚纳入该倡议。他说：“基金会 impressed by Nigeria’s focus on combating acute malnutrition and we are seeking partnership for this global ‘Operation End Starvation’ programme. We have met with the Nigeria health team and they are one of the best of many we have met.” 帕特说，这项合作将支持政府现有的抗饥饿和营养不良工作。他提到与第一夫人办公室合作实施的“国家社区食品银行计划”，这是旨在改善全国六个地缘政治区域食品获取状况的项目之一。帕特说：“尼日利亚正努力降低急性儿童营养不良患者达640万人的数字，同时关注孕妇和哺乳期女性的健康。”他补充说，多项干预措施已在实施，以应对该国面临的营养挑战。蒂努巴夫人对拟议中的合作表示欢迎，并赞扬了在不同领域工作的政府官员的专业能力和投入精神。她说：“能与帕特教授、穆伊博士等人合作，我感到非常高兴。我也与教育部和其他机构合作。如今各部门拥有的人力都非常好。”她说，博拉·蒂努巴总统政府正在推动全面改革国家体系，并补充称，尼日利亚应享有更好的公共服务，也应更有效地利用现有资源。她说：“尼日利亚值得拥有更好的条件，我们给予她的一切都不算多，因为如果这个体系运转顺畅，最终也会回馈我们。我向你们保证，无论提供什么援助，这个卫生团队都会善加利用。”她还相信，该国卫生团队有能力确保通过这项合作提供的援助得到有效使用。尼日利亚在解决儿童营养不良问题方面仍面临重大挑战，尤其是五岁以下儿童。卫生部长援引的数据显示，该国估计有640万例急性儿童营养不良病例。联邦政府表示，正在努力减轻这一负担，同时满足孕妇和母乳喂养母亲的营养需求。联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）的另一组数据估计，尼日利亚每小时约有100名五岁以下儿童死于营养不良，每天约有2,400名儿童死亡。该机构还解释说，该国估计有200万名五岁以下儿童患有重度急性营养不良（SAM），但每10名受影响儿童中只有2名接受治疗。研究显示，尼日利亚的营养不良是一个多因素问题，成因包括贫困、粮食不安全、婴幼儿喂养方式不当、无法获得医疗服务以及卫生条件恶劣。冲突、缺乏教育和性别不平等等因素也对此有所影响。《2023—2024年尼日利亚人口与健康调查》（NDHS）显示，各类营养不良问题均有所上升，包括发育迟缓、消瘦和体重不足，其中男童受影响程度略高于女童。数据显示，尼日利亚体重不足儿童中有50.64%为男性。埃莉诺·克鲁克基金会的“终结饥饿行动”倡议旨在通过与各国政府直接合作，展示大规模投资如何帮助撒哈拉以南非洲消除儿童营养不良并防止与饥饿有关的死亡

Core profit for 2026 is now expected to be on a par with the prior year’s 5.8 billion euros ($6.5 billion), the company said, down from a previously guided increase of at least 15 percent. Profit margins at the core car business are now seen at between two and three percent for the year, the firm said, down from the three to five percent previously expected. The news makes Mercedes the last of the big three German carmakers to lower their annual outlook after BMW and Volkswagen, both also citing weakness in China, the world’s largest car market. Mercedes-Benz’s vehicle deliveries in China — last year already at their lowest level since 2016 — fell a further 29 percent in the nine months to end-September. Local rivals such as Xiaomi and BYD have eaten into market share at the same time as a sluggish domestic economy has weighed on demand

https://leadership.ng/jpmorgans-nigerian.title: JPMorgan’s Nigerian Merchant Bank: 10 Things To Know
https://leadership.ng/jpmorgans-nigerian.summary: JPMorgan plans to set up a merchant bank in Nigeria, with operations expected to begin before the end of 2026. JPMorgan deposited N50 billion ($38 million) with the Central Bank of Nigeria as it moves toward a merchant banking licence. The merchant bank would deepen an existing presence.
https://leadership.ng/jpmorgans-nigerian.summary_zh: 摩根大通计划在尼日利亚设立一家商人银行，预计将于2026年底前开始运营。摩根大通正向尼日利亚中央银行存入500亿奈拉（3,800万美元），以推进申请商人银行牌照。该商人银行将进一步深化其现有业务布局。
https://leadership.ng/jpmorgans-nigerian.body: 1. It plans to launch before the year ends . JPMorgan plans to set up a merchant bank in Nigeria, with operations expected to begin before the end of 2026. 2. Regulatory approval is still pending . The plan was disclosed by the bank’s West Africa managing director and remains subject to regulatory approval. 3. It has put up the capital. JPMorgan deposited N50 billion ($38 million) with the Central Bank of Nigeria as it moves toward a merchant banking licence. 4. The approval timeline is less certain than the launch target . The central bank’s approval is expected by the end of 2026 or early 2027. The year-end launch target is therefore tight. 5. It is not a first arrival . Chase Manhattan, JPMorgan’s predecessor, opened a Lagos branch in 1961 and a representative office in 1982. The merchant bank would deepen an existing presence. 6. It already serves clients from Lagos . J.P. Morgan serves clients there through its Asset & Wealth Management and Commercial & Investment Bank businesses. 7. Ordinary customers should not expect branches or salary accounts . The merchant banking category focuses on corporate clients, investment banking and financial transactions. It is not a retail play. 8. Large companies stand to gain most . A licence would give JPMorgan a platform to serve companies seeking financing, manage cross-border transactions and support capital raising. Earlier reports linked the expansion to dollar loans for large companies, though that direction is not a confirmed product line. 9. Local banks will feel the competition. The entry could increase competition for corporate finance, investment banking and cross-border transactions. It could also push domestic institutions to improve services and open the door to partnerships. 10. A big name does not guarantee cheaper credit . An international banking name alone cannot guarantee cheaper borrowing, stable exchange rates or an investment surge. The real test is licence approval, launch, and whether it funds productive investment. We’ve got the edge. Unlock these with Subscription Ahead of Cuba’s resolution against the U.S. blockade to be taken up by the UN General Assembly on October 27, the Caribbean nation intensified its diplomatic outreach to the Global South on Sunday (October 25, 2026), with the Vice President of Cuba’s National Assembly of People’s Power and the Council of State Mari Machado meeting Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla here. Following the meeting with Ms. Machado, Mr. Birla said they had “discussed strengthening parliamentary exchanges, capacity-building and cooperation in healthcare and pharmaceuticals.” Cuba is participating in the BRICS Parliamentary Forum meeting as a partner country of the grouping. This comes two days after Cuba’s ambassador to India Juan Carlos Marsan Aguilera accused the United States of carrying out a naval blockade that has created an acute energy crisis in his country. “Cuba is fully capable of defending itself. The U.S. is practising the Monroe Doctrine in our region,” Mr. Aguilera said, seeking support for Cuba’s UNGA resolution. Mr. Birla also met the Chairman of the State Duma of Russia, Vyacheslav Volodin, on Saturday (October 24), to discuss bilateral ties. India and Russia are marking the 80th anniversary of their bilateral relationship and the two dignitaries carried out a review of parliament-level exchanges between the two countries against the backdrop of unfolding global and regional developments. The Lok Sabha Speaker informed the Russian delegation about the steps taken to make parliamentary proceedings accessible in various Indian languages through Sansad Bhashini. According to a statement issued by the Parliament Secretariat, Mr. Birla highlighted the importance of using technology in making parliamentary functioning more accessible, efficient, and people-centric. 在联合国大会将于10月27日审议古巴针对美国封锁的决议之际，这个加勒比国家于周日（2026年10月25日）加大了对全球南方国家的外交联络力度。古巴全国人民权力代表大会副主席兼国务委员会成员玛丽·马查多在此会见了人民院议长奥姆·比尔拉。

与马查多女士会面后，比尔拉先生表示，双方“讨论了加强议会交流、能力建设以及在医疗保健和药品领域的合作”。古巴正以该集团伙伴国身份参加金砖国家议会论坛会议。

这是古巴驻印度大使胡安·卡洛斯·马桑·阿吉莱拉指责美国实施海上封锁两天后发生的事情；该封锁已给古巴造成严重的能源危机。阿吉莱拉先生说：“古巴完全有能力自卫。美国正在我们所在地区推行门罗主义。”他呼吁各方支持古巴在联合国大会提出的决议。

比尔拉先生还于周六（10月24日）会见了俄罗斯国家杜马主席维亚切斯拉夫·沃洛金，双方讨论了双边关系。印度和俄罗斯正纪念两国建立双边关系80周年；面对全球和地区局势的不断发展，两国政界人士回顾了两国之间的议会层级交流。

人民院议长向俄罗斯代表团介绍了通过 Sansad Bhashini 让议会 proceedings 以多种印度语言进行的相关举措。根据议会秘书处发表的声明，比尔拉先生强调，应利用技术让议会运作更加便于公众参与、更加高效，并以人民为中心。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/27/l.summary: Promoters of Coin Finance Company Limited have demanded the return of N100.35 million paid to the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) to operate as a finance house, following the suspension of new licence applications. According to him, the investors paid N100 million as capital deposit, N100,000 as application fee and N250,000 as licensing fee on July 16, 2025, bringing the total payment to N100.35 million.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/27/l.summary_zh: Coin Finance Company Limited 的推广者要求退回向尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）缴纳的1.0035亿奈拉，以继续作为金融公司运营。此前，在暂停受理新牌照申请后，相关人士表示，投资者于2025年7月16日缴纳了1亿奈拉资本保证金、10万奈拉申请费和25万奈拉牌照费，总付款额达到1.0035亿奈拉。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/27/l.body: Promoters of Coin Finance Company Limited have demanded the return of N100.35 million paid to the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) to operate as a finance house, following the suspension of new licence applications. A representative of the promoters, Mr Christopher Itua, made the demand in a statement, saying the funds had remained with the apex bank for about 15 months without the proposed institution progressing. According to him, the investors paid N100 million as capital deposit, N100,000 as application fee and N250,000 as licensing fee on July 16, 2025, bringing the total payment to N100.35 million. The payment was made as part of the requirements for licensing Coin Finance Company Ltd as a finance house. Itua said CBN officials informed the promoters in October 2025 that processing of new finance house applications had been suspended until further notice. He explained that following the suspension, he wrote the CBN Department of Financial Policy and Regulation on October 15, 2025, requesting the return of the funds with applicable interest. The promoters later petitioned the CBN Consumer Protection Department on May 18, 2026, and sent a follow-up letter on July 7, but said they had received neither a refund timeline nor a substantive update. “It has now been over 14 months since the CBN took possession of our capital,” Itua said in his latest appeal to the CBN Governor. He said the proposed finance house was designed to address a financing gap at the grassroots and strengthen economic activity at the micro level. “The finance house is meant to boost grassroots empowerment, a sector that is very important to strengthening the micro economy,” he said. Itua noted inadequate institutions serving small businesses and grassroots entrepreneurs remained a major constraint despite improvements in the broader macroeconomic environment. “The macro is doing well, but the micro is not. This is the missing link because there are not enough institutions to power that sector,” he said. According to him, the prolonged retention of the capital had stalled the promoters’ plans to establish the institution and provide financial support at the grassroots. The investors are asking the CBN to calculate applicable interest on the N100.35 million from July 16, 2025, when the funds were deposited, until the date of release. “The prolonged silence and structural failure to return capital deposits directly undermines the Federal Government’s ease-of-doing-business initiatives,” Itua said. The promoters said their payment receipts, transaction documents and previous correspondence had been submitted to support the request. Itua appealed to the CBN Governor to intervene and resolve the matter administratively, stressing that the promoters had repeatedly used the bank’s established channels. They said continued inaction could compel them to pursue further administrative and legal channels, although they preferred to resolve the matter without escalation. The promoters are seeking the immediate return of the N100.35 million, together with applicable interest from July 16, 2025, until the funds are released. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/27/l.title_zh: 暂停发放许可证：投资者要求尼日利亚中央银行退还1.0035亿奈拉
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/27/l.body_zh: Coin Finance Company Limited的发起人要求尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）退还1.0035亿奈拉，以作为获准运营金融机构的资金，原因是新的牌照申请已被暂停。发起人代表克里斯托弗·伊图阿先生在一份声明中提出这一要求，称拟议机构尚未取得进展，但资金已在这家最高银行滞留约15个月。据他介绍，投资者于2025年7月16日支付1亿奈拉作为资本金、10万奈拉作为申请费以及25万奈拉作为牌照费，总付款额达到1.0035亿奈拉。这笔付款是为Coin Finance Company Ltd取得金融公司牌照而支付的费用。伊图阿表示，CBN官员于2025年10月告知发起人，新的金融公司申请处理工作已暂停，直至另行通知。他解释道，暂停后，他于2025年10月15日致函CBN金融政策与监管部，要求退还资金并支付适用利息。发起人后来于2026年5月18日向CBN消费者保护部提交申诉，并于7月7日发送了后续信函，但称既未收到退款时间表，也未收到实质性进展更新。伊图阿在最新一次向CBN行长提出的申诉中表示：“如今，CBN接管我们的资本金已经超过14个月。”他说，拟议中的金融公司旨在弥合基层融资缺口，并加强微型层面的经济活动。他说：“这家公司旨在推动基层赋权，而基层赋权对强化微型经济非常重要。”伊图阿指出，尽管整体宏观经济环境有所改善，但服务小型企业和基层创业者的机构仍不充足，这仍是主要制约因素。他说：“宏观层面表现良好，但微观层面并非如此。这是缺失的环节，因为没有足够的机构为该领域提供动力。”据他称，长期滞留资本金已经阻碍发起人设立该机构并在基层提供金融支持。投资者要求CBN从2025年7月16日资金存入之日起，至实际发放之日止，按照1.0035亿奈拉计算适用利息。伊图阿说：“长期沉默以及未能退还资本金的结构性失职，直接削弱了联邦政府改善营商环境的努力。”发起人表示，他们已经提交付款收据、交易文件及以往往来函件，以支持退款请求。伊图阿呼吁CBN行长介入，通过行政途径解决此事，强调发起人此前已多次使用该行既定渠道处理问题。他们表示，若继续不作为，可能迫使他们采取进一步的行政和法律途径，尽管他们更希望在事态升级前解决此事。发起人要求立即退还1.0035亿奈拉，并支付从2025年7月16日起至资金发放之日止的适用利息。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都领地以及世界各地设有办公室。该报是尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，覆盖所有平台，为政界、商业界、专业人士和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层服务，同时充当有抱负者、千禧一代探索新思想、文化和技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育、社区，以及人与社会的交叉领域。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/we-n.summary: Member representing the Lafia Central constituency at the Nasarawa State House of Assembly, Hon. Solomon Yakubu Akwashiki, has said that the people of his constituency cannot longer sleep with their two eyes closed due to the frequent abduction of the people in the constituency. The lawmaker, while raising the issue on the floor of the House on Tuesday as a matter of public interest, urged the security agencies and the state government to be more committed to protecting the lives and property of its citizens.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/we-n.summary_zh: Nasarawa州议会 Lafia Central选区议员 Hon. Solomon Yakubu Akwashiki表示，由于该选区频繁发生人员绑架事件，当地居民已无法安然闭眼入睡。这位议员周二在议会上以公共利益事项为由提出这一问题，敦促安全机构和州政府采取更有力的行动，保护公民的生命和财产安全。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/we-n.body: Member representing the Lafia Central constituency at the Nasarawa State House of Assembly, Hon. Solomon Yakubu Akwashiki, has said that the people of his constituency cannot longer sleep with their two eyes closed due to the frequent abduction of the people in the constituency. The lawmaker, while raising the issue on the floor of the House on Tuesday as a matter of public interest, urged the security agencies and the state government to be more committed to protecting the lives and property of its citizens. He said, “Mr Speaker and my honourable colleagues, I rise on a matter of frequent kidnapping in my constituency. “Yesterday, in Agyaragu Lafia, two people were kidnapped. Days back, in Agunji Lafia, people were kidnapped. “As I am talking, the two people kidnapped yesterday are in the hands of the kidnappers, and they are demanding ransom. “Security agencies and the state government should rise up to curtail the rate of kidnapping and other forms of insecurity in my constituency,” he appealed. Reacting to the alarm over a fresh resurgence of kidnapping incidents across the State, the Speaker of the House, Dr Danladi Jatau, said that the State capital and some parts of the State are experiencing frequent abductions that have caused fear and economic setbacks to the State. The speaker appreciated the mover of the motion and other colleagues for their positive contributions on the issue. “The resolution of the House is to the effect that we urge His Excellency, Gov. Abdullahi Sule, to direct all security agencies, the Commissioner of Police, and the DSS and NSCDC to beam their satellites across the state to curtail the rate of kidnapping. “All hands must be on deck, especially Chiefs and Village Heads, in collaboration with Vigilantes to identify strange people in their communities,” he said. The Speaker directed the Clerk of the House to communicate the House resolution to Gov. Sule for his necessary action. Also contributing, Hon. Esson Mairiga Esq, Hon. Onarigu Onah Kana, Hon. Ibrahim Abdullahi Sa’ad, Hon. Suleiman Yakubu Azara, Rt Hon. Abel Yakubu Bala and Hon. Larry Ven-Bawa supported the motion and called on the state government to beef up security across the state in order to curtail the rate of kidnapping in the state. They lamented how kidnapping is affecting the lives of their people negatively. The lawmakers, however, appreciated the efforts of Gov. Sule in terms of security but urged him and security agencies to be more committed to tackling the rate of kidnapping across the state. The lawmakers collectively called on security agencies to intensify operations. They called on both the federal and state governments to purchase sophisticated weapons via technology to tackle insecurity in the state. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/we-n.title_zh: “我们再也无法闭着双眼安然入睡”——纳萨拉瓦州议员痛斥绑架事件
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/we-n.body_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州议会拉菲亚中部选区议员、尊敬的所罗门·雅库布·阿克瓦希基表示，由于该选区频繁发生人员绑架事件，当地民众已无法安然入睡。这名议员周二在议会发言，将此事作为涉及公众利益的问题提出，敦促安全机构和州政府更加坚决地保护公民的生命和财产安全。他说：“议长先生及各位尊敬的同僚，我今天要提出我所选区频繁发生绑架的问题。“昨天，在阿格亚拉圭拉菲亚，有两人遭到绑架。几天前，在阿贡吉拉菲亚，也有人遭到绑架。“就在我讲话时，昨天被绑架的两人仍控制在绑匪手中，绑匪正在索要赎金。“安全机构和州政府应当采取行动，遏止我所选区的绑架及其他形式的不安全事件。”他呼吁道。针对全州绑架事件再次激增引发的警报，议长丹拉迪·贾陶博士表示，州首府及州内部分地区频繁发生绑架，给当地造成恐惧并带来经济倒退。议长对动议发起人及其他同僚就此问题作出的积极贡献表示感谢。他说：“议会的决议是，敦请尊敬的州长阿卜杜拉希·苏莱指示所有安全机构、警察局长以及国家情报局和国家民防委员会调动卫星监测力量覆盖全州，以遏止绑架事件的发生。“所有人都必须积极参与，尤其是各位酋长和村长，要与治安志愿人员合作，找出社区中的可疑人员。”他说。议长指示议会书记将议会决议传达给苏莱州长，以便其采取必要行动。尊敬的埃松·迈里加律师、尊敬的奥纳里古·奥纳·卡纳、尊敬的易卜拉欣·阿卜杜拉希·萨阿德、尊敬的苏莱曼·雅库布·阿扎拉、尊敬的阿贝尔·雅库布·巴拉阁下及尊敬的拉里·文-巴瓦也支持该动议，并呼吁州政府加强全州安全措施，以遏止该州绑架事件的发生。他们对绑架事件给当地民众生活造成的负面影响表示痛心。不过，这些议员对苏莱州长在安全方面采取的措施表示赞赏，同时敦促他与安全机构更加坚决地打击全州范围内的绑架问题。议员们一致呼吁安全机构加强行动，并呼吁联邦政府和州政府通过技术手段采购先进武器，以应对该州的不安全局势。本文所述评论不代表《Vanguard》报或该报任何员工的观点

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/tinu.body: Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives, Benjamin Kalu, has said President Bola Tinubu has approved the provision of 500,000 solar-powered lights for rural households in the South-East. Kalu disclosed this at the flag-off of the Renewed Hope Light-Up initiative, during which 26 transformers and 10,000 solar-powered lights and fans were distributed to communities in Bende Federal Constituency, Abia State. He said 42,000 households in the constituency had been earmarked to benefit from the initiative, with the first batch of 10,000 solar-powered lights and fans expected to be delivered within two weeks. According to him, 1,000 units had already been distributed as a pilot scheme, with representatives from the federal constituency’s wards confirming their functionality. Kalu said the initiative was designed to make the benefits of the Renewed Hope Agenda tangible to rural residents, particularly households that had struggled with unreliable electricity supply. He described the planned provision of solar-powered lights to 42,000 households in a single federal constituency as unprecedented, adding that the initiative would help improve access to electricity in underserved communities. The lawmaker representing Bende South Constituency in the Abia State House of Assembly, Emmanuel Ndubuisi, described the intervention as significant, noting that some communities had been without electricity for about two years following transformer failures. A representative of the project contractor, Solar Systems Nigeria, Peter Oko, said the initiative would also provide opportunities for youth training and empowerment. He assured beneficiaries of the company’s commitment to delivering quality and reliable services. Earlier, Director-General of the Ben Kalu Campaign Council, Emma Trump Eke, described the intervention as a landmark project for Bende Federal Constituency. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/tinu.title_zh: Tinubu批准为东南部家庭安装500,000盏太阳能灯
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/tinu.body_zh: 众议院副议长Benjamin Kalu表示，总统Bola Tinubu已批准为东南部农村家庭提供500,000盏太阳能灯。Kalu在“更新希望照明计划”启动仪式上披露了这一消息。期间，26台变压器以及10,000盏太阳能灯和风扇被发放给阿比亚州Bende联邦选区的各个社区。他说，该选区已有42,000户家庭被列为计划受益对象，首批10,000盏太阳能灯和风扇预计将在两周内交付。据他介绍，已有1,000套设备作为试点发放，联邦选区各选区的代表确认设备运行正常。Kalu表示，该计划旨在让农村居民切实感受到“更新希望议程”带来的益处，尤其是帮助长期面临供电不稳定问题的家庭。他称，在一个联邦选区内计划向42,000户家庭提供太阳能灯尚属首例，并补充说，该计划将有助于改善服务不足社区的用电条件。阿比亚州议院代表Bende South选区的议员Emmanuel Ndubuisi称，这项干预措施意义重大，并指出变压器故障后，一些社区已约两年没有电力供应。项目承包商Solar Systems Nigeria的代表Peter Oko表示，该计划还将为青年提供培训和赋能机会。他向受益者保证，公司致力于提供优质可靠的服务。稍早，Ben Kalu竞选委员会总干事Emma Trump Eke称，这项干预措施是Bende联邦选区的一项里程碑式项目。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报的立场及其任何员工的观点

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said Tuesday he lodged a complaint to U.S. Ambassador to Korea Michelle Steel last week over recent remarks by the chief of U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) on the inter-Korean border.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周二表示，因驻韩美军司令近期就韩朝边境问题发表言论，他上周已就此向美国驻韩大使米歇尔· steel 提出抗议。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said Tuesday he lodged a complaint to U.S. Ambassador to Korea Michelle Steel last week over recent remarks by the chief of U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) on the inter-Korean border. Controversy has arisen over comments made by USFK Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson at a seminar in Washington earlier this month, when he said that, from the U.N. Command's (UNC) perspective, Korean territory begins at the southern fence line of the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), established under the armistice that halted the 1950-53 Korean War. "Last week, I called Steel to the foreign ministry to convey our position following Brunson's remarks. I will raise the matter with the U.S. side again," Cho said during a parliamentary audit of his ministry, responding to a lawmaker's call for the government to issue "a clear warning" to Washington over the matter. Some lawmakers and critics have accused Brunson of questioning Korea's territorial sovereignty. Under the Korean Constitution, the country's territory encompasses the entire Korean Peninsula and its adjacent islands. The UNC later clarified that Korea's sovereignty was not in question, saying Brunson had been referring to the command's military and administrative responsibilities under the Armistice Agreement. The government has also conveyed its concerns through various channels, and the U.S. has indicated that it fully understands and shares Seoul's concerns, according to government sources. Lawmakers also urged the ministry to lodge a strong protest with Washington over Brunson's remarks that "conditions have changed" for Korea to retake wartime operational control (OPCON) from Washington. "I believe we should retake wartime OPCON as soon as possible," Cho said, noting that the U.S. secretary of defense had reaffirmed support for the transfer at the Shangri-La Dialogue, an annual Asian security forum, in May. "The two countries' military authorities were continuing discussions on the timing of the transfer, and the talks were proceeding well," he added. The presidential office said Seoul and Washington were continuing consultations under their existing agreement, stressing that Brunson's remarks represented his personal views and not official U.S. policy. President Lee Jae Myung has also reaffirmed his commitment to an early transfer

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周二表示，上周他就驻韩美军司令部（USFK）负责人近期有关韩朝边界的言论，向美国驻韩大使米歇尔·斯蒂尔提出交涉。本月早些时候，USFK司令官泽维尔·布伦森将军在华盛顿的一场研讨会上发表言论后，相关争议随之出现。他说，从联合国军司令部（UNC）的角度看，韩国领土始于非军事区（DMZ）的南方军事分界线；非军事区是依据《停战协定》划定的，该协定结束了1950年至1953年的朝鲜战争。赵显在其所属部委接受国会审计时表示：“上周，我致电斯蒂尔，要求她到外交部来转达我们对布伦森言论的立场。我会再次向美方提出此事。”此前，有议员要求政府就此事向华盛顿发出“明确警告”。一些议员和评论人士指责布伦森质疑韩国的领土主权。《韩国宪法》规定，韩国领土涵盖整个朝鲜半岛及其附属岛屿。联合国军司令部后来澄清称，此事并非对韩国主权提出质疑；布伦森所指的是联合国军司令部依据《停战协定》承担的军事和行政职责。政府消息人士称，政府还通过各种渠道表达了关切，美方则表示完全理解并认同首尔的担忧。议员们还敦促外交部就布伦森有关韩国重新收回战时作战指挥权（OPCON）的“情况已经发生变化”的言论，向华盛顿提出强烈抗议。赵显说：“我认为，我们应尽快收回战时作战指挥权。”他指出，美国国防部长已在5月举行的香格里拉对话会上再次支持移交该权限。香格里拉对话会是亚洲年度安全论坛。他补充说：“两国军事当局正在继续讨论移交时间，谈判进展顺利。”总统府表示，首尔和华盛顿正依据现有协议继续磋商，并强调布伦森的言论仅代表其个人观点，并非美国官方政策。总统李在明也再次重申尽早移交战时作战指挥权的承诺……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: The Katsina State Government says it has invested more than ₦4 billion to renovate and equip its Youth Craft Village, where 1,662 trainees graduated on Monday. However, the government did not provide a breakdown of the expenditure in its announcement. Governor Dikko Radda disclosed the investment at the institution’s second graduation ceremony at Muhammadu Dikko Stadium, Katsina, where the graduates received start-up equipment to establish businesses. The number of graduates rose from 648 at the maiden ceremony to 1,662, an increase of about 156 per cent. However, the government did not indicate how many of the previous graduates had established businesses or were still practising their trades. In a statement by his Chief Press Secretary, Ibrahim Kaula Mohammed, Mr Radda said the investment covered renovations, facility upgrades and the purchase of modern machines and tools. The statement did not specify the period covered by the expenditure, the amounts spent on individual projects or the value of the equipment distributed to the graduates. Mr Radda said the beneficiaries were trained in more than 15 trades, including tailoring, welding and fabrication, carpentry, electrical installation, information and communication technology, catering, cosmetology, plumbing and automobile repairs. “We do not believe in simply issuing certificates and sending our graduates home without the means to put their training into practice. That is why we are providing them with start-up tools and equipment to enable them to establish their businesses,” he said. The governor urged the graduates not to sell the equipment, saying they should use it to start businesses and employ others. He also announced plans to establish additional vocational training centres across the state’s 34 local government areas to train more than 5,000 young people before the end of his administration. Mr Radda said the government has established an innovation hub and an innovation desk at the craft village. He further disclosed that the Katsina State Enterprise Development Agency had supported more than 60,000 beneficiaries through various enterprise development programmes, although the statement did not specify the period covered or provide details of the assistance. Former Governor Ibrahim Shema, who established the Katsina Youth Craft Village during his administration, said the institution was originally intended to equip young people, particularly those from rural communities, with practical skills. He said the village had attracted trainees from other parts of Nigeria and neighbouring Niger Republic. Mr Shema also recalled meeting a former trainee who became a head of department in the Federal Capital Territory Administration. The institution’s coordinator, Kabir Soro, attributed the increase in graduate numbers to the state government’s expansion of the facility. Also speaking, the Executive Secretary of the National Board for Technical Education, Idris Bugaje, urged other states to establish similar vocational training programmes, including through community and Islamic schools

https://leadership.ng/nigeria-targets-ch.title: Nigeria Targets Chinese Capital To Boost Financial Markets
https://leadership.ng/nigeria-targets-ch.summary: Cardoso said Nigeria was particularly interested in attracting Chinese investors into its financial instruments, noting that despite China’s enormous financial resources, its participation in Nigeria’s financial markets had remained limited. The CBN’s engagement with China is expected to explore opportunities for greater participation by Chinese financial institutions in Nigeria’s markets, alongside improved payment systems and financing arrangements that could facilitate trade and investment.
https://leadership.ng/nigeria-targets-ch.summary_zh: 卡多索表示，尼日利亚尤其希望吸引中国投资者投资其金融工具，并指出，尽管中国拥有庞大的金融资源，但其对尼日利亚金融市场的参与度仍然有限。尼日利亚中央银行与中国的接触预计将探讨中国金融机构更深入参与尼日利亚市场的机会，同时推动支付系统和融资安排得到改善，以促进贸易和投资。
https://leadership.ng/nigeria-targets-ch.body: CBN Governor Olayemi Cardoso disclosed this at the closing press briefing of the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank in Bangkok, Thailand, following discussions with the Governor of the People’s Bank of China, Pan Gongsheng, on opportunities to deepen financial cooperation between both countries. Cardoso said Nigeria was particularly interested in attracting Chinese investors into its financial instruments, noting that despite China’s enormous financial resources, its participation in Nigeria’s financial markets had remained limited. “Bear in mind that, despite the considerable liquidity available in China, there has not been much investment in Nigerian financial instruments over time. This could be an opportunity to change that trajectory and generate greater interest from Asian markets in Nigerian instruments and African instruments generally.” The initiative is part of the apex bank’s broader strategy to attract long-term capital from Asian markets, diversify sources of investment and translate Nigeria’s ongoing economic reforms into increased funding for businesses and productive sectors. Cardoso said discussions with the Chinese central bank governor also covered cross-border payments, settlement arrangements, financial technology and trade finance, with a view to reducing transaction difficulties and facilitating trade and investment between both economies. “We are interested in seeing how we can deepen collaboration between institutions, including Chinese banks, the Central Bank of Nigeria, commercial banks and other institutions, particularly in the payments system,” he said. The CBN governor said Nigeria would build on the discussions during his forthcoming visit to Beijing, where technical teams from both countries would examine practical areas of cooperation. He added that the apex bank was interested in learning from China’s payment infrastructure, which he described as robust, while identifying opportunities for peer reviews between the People’s Bank of China and the CBN. “We want to avoid a situation in which these engagements become merely a talk shop,” Cardoso said. The proposed engagement comes as Nigeria seeks to widen its access to international capital and strengthen financial relationships with Asian economies, particularly at a time when businesses require sustainable financing to expand operations, increase production and support trade. Cardoso said recent improvements in Nigeria’s foreign exchange market had strengthened the prospects for attracting long-term capital, particularly investments denominated in naira. He cited the narrowing of the premium between the official and parallel market exchange rates from approximately 60 per cent to between three and four per cent, arguing that the reduction in the gap had eased currency-related uncertainty and improved the prospects for structuring long-term financial products. According to him, the risks previously associated with exchange rate volatility and sharp currency depreciation have receded considerably, creating greater opportunities for development finance institutions to mobilise and deploy long-term capital. The CBN governor, however, stressed that the apex bank would maintain its focus on monetary and price stability, while development finance institutions would be expected to channel funding into productive sectors of the economy. He specifically identified the Africa Finance Corporation, Bank of Industry and Development Bank of Nigeria as institutions expected to play key roles in directing capital towards businesses and sectors capable of supporting economic growth. The CBN’s engagement with China is expected to explore opportunities for greater participation by Chinese financial institutions in Nigeria’s markets, alongside improved payment systems and financing arrangements that could facilitate trade and investment. For Nigeria, attracting a greater share of Chinese capital could provide an additional source of funding for financial instruments and businesses, while deeper cooperation between both countries’ financial institutions could improve the channels through which trade-related payments and investments are processed. https://leadership.ng/nigeria-targets-ch.title_zh: 尼日利亚寻求中国资本，以提振金融市场
https://leadership.ng/nigeria-targets-ch.body_zh: 尼日利亚中央银行行长奥拉耶米·卡多索在泰国曼谷举行的2026年国际货币基金组织（IMF）和世界银行年会闭幕新闻发布会上透露了上述情况。此前，他曾与中国人民银行行长潘功胜举行会谈，讨论深化两国金融合作的机会。卡多索表示，尼日利亚尤其希望吸引中国投资者投资其金融工具，并指出，尽管中国拥有庞大的金融资源，但中国参与尼日利亚金融市场的程度仍然有限。卡多索说：“请记住，尽管中国拥有充裕的流动性，但长期以来，对尼日利亚金融工具的投资并不多。这或许是改变这一趋势的机会，并促使亚洲市场对尼日利亚金融工具以及更广泛的非洲金融工具产生更大兴趣。”这项举措是该央行更广泛战略的一部分，旨在吸引亚洲市场的长期资本、实现投资来源多元化，并将尼日利亚持续推进的经济改革转化为为企业及生产部门提供的更多融资。卡多索表示，他与中国央行行长的讨论还涵盖跨境支付、结算安排、金融科技和贸易融资，希望借此减少交易障碍，促进两国经济之间的贸易与投资。他说：“我们希望探索如何深化各机构之间的合作，包括中国银行、尼日利亚中央银行、商业银行及其他机构，尤其是在支付系统方面。”尼日利亚中央银行行长表示，尼日利亚将在即将对北京进行的访问中推进此次讨论，届时两国技术团队将研究可落实的合作领域。他补充说，该央行希望借鉴中国支付基础设施的建设经验，并称中国支付基础设施十分完善，同时希望寻找中国人民银行与尼日利亚中央银行开展同行评审的机会。卡多索说：“我们不希望这些交流变成纸上谈兵。”在尼日利亚寻求拓宽国际资本渠道并加强与亚洲各国金融关系的背景下，提出开展上述交流尤其具有现实意义，因为当前企业需要可持续融资来扩大运营、提高产量并支持贸易。卡多索表示，尼日利亚外汇市场近期改善，增强了吸引长期资本的前景，尤其是以奈拉计价的投资。他提到，官方与平行市场汇率之间的溢价已从约60%收窄至3%至4%之间；这一差距缩小缓解了与货币有关的不确定性，并提高了设计长期金融产品的可行性。据他此前与汇率波动及货币大幅贬值有关的风险已大幅消退，为开发融资机构筹集和投放长期资本创造了更多机会。不过，尼日利亚中央银行行长强调，该央行将继续专注于货币和价格稳定，而开发融资机构则应当把资金导向经济的生产部门。他特别列举了非洲金融公司、工业银行和尼日利亚开发银行，表示这些机构预计将在把资本导向企业及能够支持经济增长的部门方面发挥关键作用。尼日利亚中央银行与中国的接触预计将探索中国金融机构更多参与尼日利亚市场的机会，同时改善支付系统和融资安排，以促进贸易与投资。对尼日利亚而言，吸引更大比例的中国资本可以为金融工具和企业提供额外融资来源，而两国金融机构深化合作则可改善与贸易有关的支付和投资处理渠道。获取独家优势。实时报道、独家内幕和独到视角直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp频道，随时获取全天候最新动态 →

https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.summary: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 suspects, comprising 14 Chinese and one Nigerian, at four illegal lithium processing plants in the Ogere area of Ogun State. The commission disclosed this in a post on its official X account, stating that operatives of its Lagos Zonal Directorate 2 carried out the arrests on Friday, October 23, 2026, following credible intelligence and surveillance.
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.summary_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）在奥贡州奥格雷地区4家非法锂加工厂逮捕了15名嫌疑人，其中包括14名中国人和1名尼日利亚人。该委员会在官方X账号发布的一则帖文中透露，拉各斯第2分局执法人员于2026年10月23日星期五根据可靠情报和 surveillance 实施了逮捕。
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 suspects, comprising 14 Chinese and one Nigerian, at four illegal lithium processing plants in the Ogere area of Ogun State. The commission disclosed this in a post on its official X account, stating that operatives of its Lagos Zonal Directorate 2 carried out the arrests on Friday, October 23, 2026, following credible intelligence and surveillance. Items recovered during the operation included bags of lithium rocks, 18 mobile devices, four computer laptops, two decoders, a television remote control and a trailer truck. The EFCC said the recovered items had been taken as part of its investigation into the activities of the facilities, adding that the suspects would be charged to court upon the conclusion of investigations. However, the agency did not disclose the specific offences the suspects were alleged to have committed or the ownership of the processing plants. Lithium has become a highly sought-after mineral globally because of its critical role in manufacturing rechargeable batteries used in electric vehicles, smartphones, laptops and renewable energy storage systems. Growing demand for electric vehicles and clean energy technologies has intensified the race to secure lithium supplies, making the mineral increasingly valuable and creating incentives for illegal mining and processing. Nigeria is emerging as a new source of lithium in Africa as the world’s largest producers, like Australia and Chile, are unable to fulfil the growing demand worldwide. However, illegal activities thrive in Nigeria’s extractive sector, denying the government due revenues of up to $9 billion, according to the Nigeria Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (NEITI). The country’s lithium deposits have attracted growing interest from local and foreign operators, while concerns over unregulated extraction, revenue losses, environmental degradation, and the potential circumvention of mining regulations have heightened calls for stricter enforcement. https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.title_zh: 非法锂矿开采：经济和金融犯罪委员会在奥贡州拘捕14名中国人和1名尼日利亚人
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）在奥贡州奥盖雷地区的4家非法锂加工厂逮捕了15名嫌疑人，其中14名为中国人、1名为尼日利亚人。该委员会在其官方X账号发布的一则消息中披露，拉各斯第2区分局行动人员于2026年10月23日星期五根据可靠情报和监视行动实施了逮捕。行动中缴获的物品包括装在袋中的锂矿石、18部移动设备、4台笔记本电脑、2个解码器、1个电视遥控器和1辆拖挂卡车。EFCC表示，缴获的物品已作为调查这些工厂经营活动的一部分被查扣，并称调查结束后将把嫌疑人移交法院起诉。然而，该机构没有披露嫌疑人被指控实施的具体罪行，也没有披露这些加工厂的归属。锂已成为全球备受追捧的矿产，因为它在制造用于电动汽车、智能手机、笔记本电脑和可再生能源储存系统的可充电电池方面发挥着关键作用。电动汽车和清洁能源技术需求不断增长，加剧了各国争夺锂供应的竞争，使这种矿产的价值日益提高，也刺激了非法采矿和加工活动。随着澳大利亚和智利等全球最大生产国无法满足全球不断增长的需求，尼日利亚正成为非洲新的锂来源。然而，尼日利亚采掘业的非法活动十分猖獗，使政府损失最高达90亿美元的收入，据尼日利亚采掘业透明度倡议（NEITI）称。该国的锂矿藏吸引了越来越多的本地和外国运营商关注，同时，对不受监管的开采、收入流失、环境破坏以及规避采矿法规的担忧，也强化了要求加强执法的呼声。Adedapo Adesanya是一名记者、多才多艺的学者，也是艺术各个领域的行家。不写作时，他不是埋首阅读自己收藏夹中的众多书籍或文章之一，就是拿着一瓶啤酒或葡萄酒聆听好音乐。他支持世界上最伟大的俱乐部——Manchester United F.C.

It said this temporary measure aimed to improve the smooth running of operations while guaranteeing deliveries and the availability of petrol, following a countrywide shortage. But the measure is impacting taxis drivers, like Moussa Idé Boubacar, who said he has not been able to make his payments for two days. “Normally, we generate revenue of around 20,000 a day, of which 8,000 is for payments and 12,000 is for fuel. With this shortage, we’ve had some management issues,” he said. As the fuel shortage spread, motorists have been facing increasingly long queues at stations. Residents in the capital, Niamey, and elsewhere said this was disrupting daily life, making it difficult to get to work and carry out their daily activities. The taxi union, Synctaxi, has called for the new curfew to be relaxed for operators who are struggling to make ends meet. “To obtain fuel, you need authorisation. The petrol station must be open around the clock,” said it secretary-general, Ganda Sanda. “We are appealing to the governorate and the governor as well to reconsider because it does not suit us,” he said. Sanda added that the union wanted to draw the authorities’ attention to the fact that the transport sector “makes a significant contribution to the country’s development”. https://x.com/amborin/status/21154911112.title: "Russia can technologically help the US build an LNG plant in Alaska...the Polar LNG project worth $25 billion" "What does Russia need from
https://x.com/amborin/status/21154911112.snippet:
"Russia can technologically help the US build an LNG plant in Alaska...the Polar LNG project worth $25 billion"

"What does Russia need from the US in the Arctic? "two things...first is the market, second is iron. The lifting of sanctions on the Arctic LNG-2 and its LNG carriers will bring back buyers from Japan, India, Southeast Asia and remove the discount that is now being taken away by the only client - China"

"A diesel deal with the United States, an opportunity to expand the supply of Russian fertilizers, and now Russia is offering to work together in the Arctic. How could the Arctic unite Russia and the United States, and what can Moscow offer Washington in return for lifting sanctions on Russian gas?

Russia is working on the possibility of joint work with the United States in the Arctic, Russian President Vladimir Putin said.

"In the Arctic, which I mentioned, we are actively working with many countries of the world and are interested in working together. Quite recently, European partners worked with us in our fields. Now we are working on the possibility of joint work with American partners," Putin said at the summit of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum (GECF).

What kind of joint work with the United States can Russia have?

We are talking about LNG projects. Indeed, after 2022, due to sanctions against Russia, European companies withdrew from participating in gas projects with Russia - in Yamal LNG and Arctic LNG-2. However, cooperation with Chinese companies has reached a new level, says Igor Yushkov, an expert at the National Energy Security Fund (NEF) and the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation. There are two Chinese shareholders in the Arctic LNG 2 - CNPC and CNOOC, which were initially afraid of US sanctions against the project and froze their participation. However, Beijing did not change its policy, just the Chinese companies CNPC and CNOOC did not risk access to the dollar, says Mikhail Vakilyan, an expert at the Institute for the Development of Fuel and Energy Technologies.

But after a year and a half, everything changed. In the second half of 2025, China began buying gas from the sanctioned Arctic LNG-2 plant, allocating an entire terminal for the project, and this year opened a second terminal only for Russian LNG. China has even resumed the delivery of modules for the completion of the third stage of the Arctic LNG-2, although earlier deliveries were suspended.

What does Russia need from the United States in the Arctic? "Russia needs two things. The first is the market, the second is iron. The lifting of sanctions on the Arctic LNG-2 and its LNG carriers will bring back buyers from Japan, India, Southeast Asia and remove the discount that is now being taken away by the only client - China. As for iron, the liquefaction compressors at Yamal LNG and Arctic LNG-2 drive the turbines of Baker Hughes, and this is an American company. Service, spare parts and modernization of these cars run into American export bans," says Vakilyan.

"Here is the same scheme as with the diesel deal. We offer the United States mutually beneficial projects and cooperation in the economy in general in exchange for easing anti-Russian sanctions and putting pressure on Ukraine. We show that this cooperation can be very multifaceted and in different areas: diesel, fertilizers, LNG, and so on,"
says the expert of the National Energy Security Fund and the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation.

What can Russia offer the United States in the field of LNG in exchange for the lifting of sanctions? Russia can technologically help the United States build an LNG plant in Alaska. We are talking about the Polar LNG project worth $25 billion.

"Novatek has a technological solution for the LNG project in Alaska, which it applied to the Arctic LNG 2. These are reinforced concrete platforms on which liquefaction equipment is poured - and this is, in fact, an LNG plant. Novatek has already built two such platforms with equipment, and has built a center for the construction of large-capacity offshore structures in Belokamenka. The problem is that both this center and the Arctic LNG-2 plant itself fell under US sanctions. Therefore, we can build such a plant in Alaska in exchange for the lifting of sanctions at least from the center for the construction of large-capacity platforms," Yushkov says.

According to him, Russia can pour a platform in this center, build the LNG plant itself on it and only then drive it to Alaska. This is a simpler solution, because it is expensive to build something in the Arctic itself, and creates restrictions on time and the possibility of importing equipment, etc.

"It is not a fact that this story will come to fruition, because there are many sanctions problems and questions about the economics of the project, but nevertheless, the Americans are interested in our technologies for Alaska, and Russia uses and says that it can do it,"
says Yushkov. However, we should not forget that Russia is the main competitor of the United States in terms of gas, and in recent years, the American leadership has consistently squeezed Russian gas out of the European market, the expert adds. And helping LNG from the United States to occupy the market share that the Russian Federation has lost is not a good idea.

However, in addition to the Arctic LNG 2, there is another Russian project that could benefit from cooperation with the United States. This is Yamal LNG, which is not affected by US sanctions. However, the problem is different. From January 1, 2027, the EU bans the supply of any Russian LNG. "In the first half of the year, Europe took almost all of the plant's products - 9.89 million tons. In two months, these volumes need a new route and a new buyer – and an American trader looks natural in this place," says Vakilyan."

-Vzglyad

“俄罗斯可以在技术上帮助美国在阿拉斯加建造液化天然气工厂……这就是价值250亿美元的极地LNG项目”

“俄罗斯在北极地区需要美国提供什么？有两样东西……第一是市场，第二是钢铁。取消对Arctic LNG-2及其液化天然气运输船的制裁，将让日本、印度和东南亚的买家回归，并消除目前唯一客户——中国所获得的折扣。至于钢铁，Yamal LNG和Arctic LNG-2的液化压缩机会驱动Baker Hughes的涡轮机，而Baker Hughes是一家美国公司。这些设施的维护、备件供应和现代化改造都受到美国出口禁令的限制。”——瓦基利扬

“俄罗斯与美国达成柴油协议、扩大俄罗斯化肥供应的机会，如今俄罗斯又提出在北极地区合作。北极地区如何促成俄罗斯与美国联手，作为解除对俄罗斯天然气制裁的回报，莫斯科又能向华盛顿提供什么？

俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京表示，俄罗斯正在研究与美国在北极地区合作的可能性。

普京在天然气出口国论坛峰会上说：“在我刚才提到的北极地区，我们正积极与世界上许多国家开展合作，也希望携手合作。就在不久前，欧洲伙伴还曾在我们的油气田与我们合作。现在，我们正在研究与美国伙伴开展合作的可能性。”

俄罗斯可以在哪些方面与美国开展合作？

这涉及液化天然气项目。确实，2022年以后，由于对俄罗斯实施制裁，欧洲企业退出了参与俄罗斯天然气项目，包括Yamal LNG和Arctic LNG-2。然而，俄罗斯联邦政府下属国家能源安全基金和金融大学的专家伊戈尔·尤什科夫表示，与中国企业的合作已经提升到新的水平。Arctic LNG 2有两名中国股东，即CNPC和CNOOC。两家公司最初担心美国会制裁该项目，因而暂停参与。不过，北京并未改变政策，只是中国公司CNPC和CNOOC不愿冒着使用美元结算的风险。燃料与能源技术发展研究所专家米哈伊尔·瓦基利扬如是说。

但一年半后，情况发生了变化。2025年下半年，中国开始从受制裁的Arctic LNG-2工厂采购天然气，为该项目划拨了一整座码头，今年又启用了一座专门接收俄罗斯液化天然气的码头。中国甚至恢复了为Arctic LNG-2第三阶段完工所需模块的交付，而此前这些交付已暂停。

俄罗斯在北极地区需要美国提供什么？瓦基利扬说：“俄罗斯需要两样东西。第一是市场，第二是钢铁。取消对Arctic LNG-2及其液化天然气运输船的制裁，将让日本、印度和东南亚的买家回归，并消除目前唯一客户——中国所获得的折扣。至于钢铁，Yamal LNG和Arctic LNG-2的液化压缩机会驱动Baker Hughes的涡轮机，而Baker Hughes是一家美国公司。这些设施的维护、备件供应和现代化改造都受到美国出口禁令的限制。”

“这与柴油协议采用的是同一套模式。我们向美国提供互利项目以及整体经济合作，以换取放松对俄制裁，并向乌克兰施压。我们表明，这种合作可以非常广泛，涵盖不同领域，包括柴油、化肥和液化天然气等。”——俄罗斯联邦政府下属国家能源安全基金和金融大学的专家

作为解除制裁的回报，俄罗斯可以在液化天然气领域向美国提供什么？俄罗斯可以在技术上帮助美国在阿拉斯加建造液化天然气工厂。这指的是价值250亿美元的极地LNG项目。

尤什科夫说：“Novatek拥有适用于阿拉斯加液化天然气项目的技术方案，并已将这套方案用于Arctic LNG 2。这是在钢筋混凝土平台上浇筑液化设备，而平台本身就是一座液化天然气工厂。Novatek已经建造了两座配有设备的此类平台，还在别洛卡缅卡建造了一座大型海上结构物建造中心。问题在于，这座建造中心和Arctic LNG-2工厂本身都受到美国制裁。因此，至少只要取消对大型平台建造中心的制裁，我们就可以在阿拉斯加建造这样一座工厂。”

据他介绍，俄罗斯可以在该建造中心浇筑平台，在平台上建成液化天然气工厂，之后再将其运往阿拉斯加。这是一种更简单的方案，因为在北极地区直接建造设施成本高昂，还会受到工期以及进口设备可能性等方面的限制。

尤什科夫说：“这件事最终能否实现尚无定论，因为其中涉及许多制裁问题和项目经济性问题。尽管如此，美国人对我们用于阿拉斯加的技术感兴趣，而俄罗斯也能做到，并表示自己有能力完成。”不过，这位专家补充称，俄罗斯在天然气领域是美国的主要竞争对手。近年来，美国领导层一直设法将俄罗斯天然气挤出欧洲市场。帮助美国液化天然气重新占据俄罗斯联邦失去的市场份额并不是好主意。

然而，除了Arctic LNG 2之外，还有另一个可能从与美国合作中获益的俄罗斯项目，即不受美国制裁影响的Yamal LNG。不过，它面临的是另一个问题。自2027年1月1日起，欧盟将禁止供应任何俄罗斯液化天然气。瓦基利扬说：“今年上半年，欧洲采购了该工厂几乎全部产品，约为989万吨。两个月内，这些货量就需要寻找新的运输路线和新的买家，而美国贸易商显然是合适的选择。”

——《观察》

https://x.com/grok/status/21153377688762.snippet:
Chinese/Russian deals centered on oil-for-loan financing: China lent tens of billions repaid via discounted crude shipments (often no cash), with CNPC/Sinopec JVs in underdeveloped fields. Russia used similar loans and Rosneft/Roszarubezhneft stakes for oil prepayments. Goals: secure cheap energy supplies and geopolitical footholds amid sanctions. Venezuela gained credit access but received limited investment, low production gains, and reduced revenue.

The US deal grants NABEP (US-backed, 35% gov stake) 100-year concessions on 17 fields (~65B barrels, some prior Chinese/Russian ops). Goals: displace rivals, secure crisis reserves/SPR access (20% at cost + first refusal), revive output via up to $100B investment. Venezuela gets royalties/taxes (~$19/bbl, $200B+ projected), jobs, and market-oriented production growth—but faces long-term lock-in and legitimacy questions from opposition.

https://x.com/grok/status/21153377688762.title_zh: 中俄协议以石油换贷款融资为核心：中国出借数百亿美元，并通过打折的原油运输偿还（往往无需现金）
https://x.com/grok/status/21153377688762.snippet_zh:
中俄交易以石油换贷款融资为中心：中国出借数百亿美元，并通过打折原油运输偿还（通常无需支付现金），同时在中国石油/中国石化与俄罗斯 undeveloped 油田成立的合资企业中投资。俄罗斯也利用类似贷款，以及俄罗斯石油公司/俄罗斯石油 Roszarubezhneft 的股份换取石油预付款。目标是在制裁之下确保廉价的能源供应并建立地缘政治立足点。委内瑞拉获得了信贷渠道，但得到的投资有限、产量增长有限、收入也有所下降。

美国协议授予NABEP（美国支持、拥有35%政府股份）17个油田的100年特许经营权（约650亿桶，其中一些油田此前由中俄企业运营）。目标是排挤竞争对手、确保危机储备以及获得战略石油储备的使用权（以成本价购买20%，并享有优先购买权），通过最多1000亿美元投资恢复产量。委内瑞拉将获得特许权使用费和税费（约为每桶19美元，预计总额超过2000亿美元）、就业岗位以及面向市场的产量增长——但也将面临长期锁定风险，以及反对派对其合法性的质疑。

Beijing has described the actions of its military as routine patrolling, following reports of fresh standoffs along the disputed border. New Delhi maintains that Chinese units occasionally deviate from established routes, thereby disrupting the peace.

At a briefing on October 26, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun stated that China adheres to the agreements and urged India to work together to uphold them. https://x.com/blcbuster/status/211511945.snippet:
A video circulating on social media has sparked discussion over border security along the India-China frontier. The footage is being shared with claims that Indian Army personnel confronted Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA) soldiers allegedly attempting to cross into Indian territory near Arunachal Pradesh.

According to the claims accompanying the video, the Chinese personnel were intercepted and later released under established border protocols along the Line of Actual Control (LAC).

However, the video’s authenticity, date, location and the circumstances of the alleged confrontation have not been independently verified. No definitive conclusion can be drawn from the circulating footage alone.

India and China have experienced border tensions in the past, making incidents along the LAC a matter of significant public interest. The latest claims require confirmation from official sources before the video can be treated as evidence of an actual border confrontation.

Fact Check: The specific incident remains unverified. The video’s original source, date and location, along with any official statements from Indian authorities, need to be established. #IndianArmy
